w: Swamishri visited the Swaminarayan mandir in Bhuj, built by Lord Swaminarayan, and paid reverence to all the holy places. Swamishri also visited the homes of Sunderji and Hirji Suthar - staunch devotees of Lord Swaminarayan.
From Bhuj, Swamishri arrived at Madapur village at 11.55 a.m. After addressing the devotees, Swamishri reached Gandhidham at 8.30 p.m.

In the evening Swamishri arrived in Nadiad and attended the welcome assembly. BAPS youths of Adas performed a welcome dance and BAPS youths of Nadiad honored Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Today, Swamishri was weak and pale. He still had a fever. With over 47,000 devotees having gathered for the Fuldol festival Swamishri arrived in the assembly hall at 10.30 am. He initiated thirteen youths into the parshad diksha. Then after colouring Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, Swamishri showered holy coloured water on the senior sadhus and devotees. At 11.10 am Swamishri departed from the festival venue. By evening Swamishri’s fever subsided and in the next few days he recovered quickly.
Holi and Pushpadolotsav (Fuldol) festivals are celebrated throughout India. Bhagwan Swaminarayan also celebrated Fuldol, the festival of colors with great spiritual joy and festivity.

Every year Pramukh Swami Maharaj celebrates fuldol festival in Sarangpur This year devotees from distant places in India like Hyderabad, Chennai , Kolkata, New Delhi, Mumbai and from abroad flocked enthusiastically to the rural environment of Sarangpur. The privileged opportunity to be colored by Swamishri becomes the focus of all devotees. Besides the enlightening spiritual discourses and bhajans, the crowning moment was defined by the shower of colored water issuing from jets sanctified and maneuvered by Swamishri.

This year, on Saturday, 26 March 2005, the Fuldol festival commenced with the routine dhun and bhajan by sadhus. The colorful tree-decorations on stage gave a festive flair to the occasion. The senior sadhus elaborated in their speeches upon the sentiments and significance of Fuldol. Pujya Viveksagar Swami gave the historical details of this festival and expanded upon how Swamishri colors and transforms the lives of people.

Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami explained the need to shed I 'ness' and My 'ness' towards one's self and one's relatives and adopt the virtue of humility to please God. Pujya Doctor Swami described the need to integrate and practice satsang in one's lives by adhering to niyams and fostering faith in Bhagwan Swaminarayan as God, Gunatitanand Swami as Aksharbrahma and Pramukh Swami Maharaj as the gateway to moksha. Pujya Mahant Swami explained the need to purge oneself of one's 'swabhavs' and cultivate divinity towards God and His Sadhu. He described that Swamishri has lived for all of us, done everything at our bidding and now it was our duty to obey and adjust to his wishes and ways. Pujya Kothari Swami spoke about the divinity of Swamishri's deeds.

At about 11.00 am Swamishri arrived. Despite a fever the previous day, Swamishri came to bless the assembly of sadhus and devotees. Firstly Swamishri gave the guru mantra to 13 youths who were given the parshad diksha. Thereafter Swamishri sprayed colored water on Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Then Swamishri sprayed colored water on the senior sadhus. In conclusion, Swamishri sprayed the sadhus and devotees.

Every year the preparations for the festival begin two to three months in advance. More than 50 departments, namely, construction, kitchen, accommodation, parking, electric, decoration, etc. are managed by a huge team of sadhus and youth volunteers. The sheer devotion and dedication of the volunteers result in the smooth execution of the festival.
After his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS hari mandirs at Sonasan (Himatnagar district), Vadu (Mehasana district) and Dared (Gadhada district).

st.t: Earth Hour Celebration at Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: On 26 March 2011 at 8:30 p.m., Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi participated in the international celebration of Earth Hour. For one hour, Swaminarayan Akshardham supported this worldwide commitment towards environmental conservation by switching-off its lights.

Around the world, Earth Hour is embraced by the global community, transcending race, culture, age and economics as individuals and organizations take leadership in their communities in the pursuit of a cleaner and safer planet.

In 2011, hundreds of millions of people took part in the one hour switch-off to celebrate the Earth Hour, which encourages an energy-saving lifestyle to help minimize the degradation of the earth’s natural environment, and reduce pollution and the carbon footprint.

Earth Hour now has global support in which world famous and iconic places on all seven continents participate, for example: Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge in Australia, the Colosseum of Rome, Italy; the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt; Malaysia’s Petronas Twin Towers; the Empire State Building and Mount Rushmore in the USA; Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir, Rashtrapati Bhavan and India Gate in India.

While the book "Digantma Danka" was being read before Mahant Swami Maharaj, the talk turned to Rolanand, a sadhu from the time of Shriji Maharaj. Harinarayandas Swami asked: "You have remembered Rolanand so many times, so surely he has attained liberation?!"

Swamishri said: "Yes." Then he explained: "A saw cuts this way and it cuts that way too. Once a soul comes into contact with Maharaj, the cycle of the 84 (lakh births) is ended. In 2 or 4 births, one way or another, he removes the shortcomings. This is his grace alone. God is attained through grace. Nothing happens by one's own effort. We have had countless births and made only our own efforts, but nothing came of it. Maharaj came and made a resolve (Swamishri snapped his fingers): even the mud is to be taken along."
A sadhu asked: "Should we make some effort of our own to receive such grace?"
"Just stay steady, that's all!" said Swamishri.
Then he added: "If one wavers, there is delay. One may have to take 50 or 60 births. God is simply waiting to seat us in his abode. If we stay steady, he will somehow take us under his wing."

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the Children's Day assembly. The children presented a programme called "Meeting of the Children's Trustee Board." As part of it, the children together asked Swamishri: "Swami! Please tell us yourself what we should do to keep you happy, healthy and relaxed."
In reply, giving his blessings, Swamishri said something wonderful: "We like capital S, capital A, capital M, capital P."

Swamishri had all the child trustees say these 4 letters along with him. Then he said: "And also seeing others as faultless, suhradbhav, seva (selfless service): we like all of these. Yogibapa taught us this, and this is what we must do. So we obey the guru's command. Pramukh Swami Maharaj also likes this, so we should keep samp, suhradbhav and unity. Alright?"
Everyone said together in a loud voice: "Yes."
